JCOnlyField.BUNotes:
Delayed Startup Warranty
The delayed startup warranty must be purchased before initial unit startup AND prior to expiration of the 12/18 standard warranty. The warranty is valid only on equipment located within the domestic U.S. or Canada.
This optional warranty can postpone the commencement dates of all purchased warranties on the unit. The Delayed startup will provide coverage beyond expiration of the 12/18 standard warranty based on the term purchased. For example, a 12/30 delayed startup will provide coverage for 12 months from startup not to exceed 30 months from shipment. Delayed startup warranties of 12/32 and longer require a startup inspection to be performed by the Trane affiliated service company with a report sent to Extended Warranties in La Crosse.
Delayed startup does not postpone commencement of any product standard warranties, and will not provide more than 12 months of warranty coverage. For complete terms and conditions of this warranty, please reference literature # SRV-PRC009C-EN available on e-Library.
Pricing obtained herein is applicable only if the warranty is ordered at the same time and on the same sales order as the equipment. Pricing for extended warranties being ordered after the equipment has shipped must be obtained from the Extended Warranty department in La Crosse (608-787-3949).

Beyond 1st Year Labor Warranty
NOTE: An equal or greater amount of parts warranty MUST also be purchased with the labor warranty.
The Beyond 1st Year Labor Warranty (2nd year plus) begins at the end of the 12/18 standard parts warranty and applies only to the repair/replacement of parts that fail due to a defect in material or manufacture. Standard terms and conditions apply to this warranty. The warranty is valid only on equipment located within the domestic U.S. or Canada.
Repair to parts not provided by Trane is not covered.
A Trane warranty agent must perform warranty repair labor. Labor by others is not covered unless for a specific operation or skill not possessed by the Trane warranty agent and pre-approved by Extended Warranties in La Crosse.
For complete terms and conditions of this warranty, please reference literature # SRV-PRC009C-EN available on e-Library.
Pricing obtained herein is applicable only if the warranty is ordered at the same time and on the same sales order as the equipment. Pricing for extended warranties being ordered after the equipment has shipped must be obtained from the Extended Warranty department in La Crosse (608-787-3949).
Payment of a labor claim is based on standard hour allowances and the Trane approved labor rate.

1st Year Labor Warranty
The 1st Year Labor Warranty runs concurrent to the 12/18 standard parts warranty and applies only to the repair/replacement of parts that fail due to a defect in material or manufacture. Standard terms and conditions apply to this warranty. The warranty is valid only on equipment located within the domestic U.S. or Canada.
Repair to parts not provided by Trane is not covered.
A Trane warranty agent must perform warranty repair labor. Labor by others is not covered unless for a specific operation or skill not possessed by the Trane warranty agent and pre-approved by Extended Warranties in La Crosse.
For complete terms and conditions of this warranty, please reference literature # SRV-PRC009C-EN available on e-Library.
Pricing obtained herein is applicable only if the warranty is ordered at the same time and on the same sales order as the equipment. Pricing for extended warranties being ordered after the equipment has shipped must be obtained from the Extended Warranty department in La Crosse (608-787-3949).
Payment of a labor claim is based on standard hour allowances and the Trane approved labor rate.

Parts - Whole unit
The Whole Unit Parts Warranty is a continuation of the 12/18 standard parts warranty and the standard terms and conditions, and is valid only on equipment located within the domestic U.S. or Canada.
Replacement parts used for repairs to the covered equipment are to be obtained through a Trane parts center. Only Trane approved parts are covered.
For complete terms and conditions of this warranty, please reference literature # SRV-PRC009C-EN available on e-Library.
Pricing obtained herein is applicable only if the warranty is ordered at the same time and on the same sales order as the equipment. Pricing for extended warranties being ordered after the equipment has shipped must be obtained from the Extended Warranty department in La Crosse (608-787-3949).
Parts given in satisfaction of this warranty do not include a warranty of their own. The standard and extended warranties remain in effect for the term originally purchased.
